Technical Summary:

Solar panels generate electricity by using special materials, like silicon, to capture energy from sunlight. When sunlight hits these materials, it energizes tiny particles called electrons, causing them to move. This movement creates an electrical current that can be used as power. This process is a clean energy source that helps reduce our dependence on fossil fuels and lowers harmful greenhouse gas emissions.
